fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant was allegedly pushed and struck during a street argument at Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore. The matter was brought to Coimbatore North PS on 2025-10-22, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-21 around 22:30 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Arun Prakash (9000000194). No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. A white car with registration TN-38-XX-1015 was observed near Roja Park Main Street. The complainant alleged that Kishore Arumugam may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000189. Vignesh Balan (9000000105), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place.
fields.Keywords: altercation, street dispute, mobile number, photograph, associate, car, suspect, main street
